描述_ZN: A four-legged covered stove with green glaze from Changsha kilns, Song dynasty, 8.5 cm high, 8 cm in diameter, 8.3 cm from the foot.　　The lid is modelled after an ancient bronze vessel, with a converging mouth, straight belly and folded bottom, bearing four feet. The cover rises in the shape of a helmet, decorated with a pearl button, decorated with a long strip of hollowing around each, and decorated with brown color on the top of the cover. The body is glazed with green glaze, glaze is less than the bottom, glaze green in yellow, elegant and soft, glaze surface has a small open pattern.　　This kind of furnace is also known as incense smoke, for incense use. Stove cover more for carved decoration, will be burned spices placed in the furnace, curling smoke from the hollow floating out, such as clouds and fog. Porcelain incense burner was first seen in the Eastern Wu, more popular in the Six Dynasties, more trays, stove body large, cover surface hollow, generous style. After the Tang Dynasty, the tray was changed to three-footed or five-footed, with small and dense hollowing.　　Changsha kiln, also known as Tongguan kiln, Wangcheng kiln and Wajiaping kiln, is known as Changsha kiln because it is under the jurisdiction of Changsha City. Founded in the Middle Tang Dynasty and flourished in the Late Tang and Five Dynasties, Changsha Kiln is a large folk porcelain kiln of great scale and skill. The decorative techniques of Changsha kiln porcelain include incised flowers, molded decals, sculptures and underglaze decorations, of which underglaze is the most famous. The coloring materials used are mainly green coloring with copper oxide as the coloring agent and brown coloring with iron oxide as the coloring agent. According to the painting technique, it can be divided into four kinds of underglaze brown color spot pattern, underglaze green color spot pattern, underglaze green color painting and underglaze brown green color painting.　　This vessel is neat and generous in shape, with heavy body and decorated with underglaze brown color on the lid surface, with different shades of glaze, which is highly decorative.
